items.title: AI Agents Keep Escaping Their Creators' Control—Here's What We Know
items.summary: An OpenAI agent's breach of an Australian government website is the starkest example yet of a pattern building for months—and of how hard autonomous AI is to contain.

items.title: THORChain Pushes Back on Bitget’s Demand to Block Hacker Addresses
items.summary: An address flagged by Bitget completed an XRP-to-bitcoin swap after the request, while OKX’s Star Xu challenged THORChain’s comparison with Bitcoin.

items.title: ‘It’s really not just a blockchain anymore’: Vitalik Buterin maps Ethereum’s path to 2030
items.summary: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin said Ethereum is "really not just a blockchain anymore" and laid out how its design will change by 2030 in a post.

items.title: Vitalik Buterin maps Ethereum’s shift beyond a blockchain in sweeping 2030 vision
items.summary: Buterin wants Ethereum to do far more work without forcing every computer on the network to repeat the same calculations.
